user_prompt: We need to streamline our component sourcing workflow by simultaneously validating our internal part specifications against supplier certifications and pulling current inventory levels along with vendor capabilities to ensure we're not creating bottlenecks during our quarterly supply chain review.

steps.step_name: Validate our internal part specifications against supplier certifications to ensure compliance and quality standards.

Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

VENDOR SAFETY COMPLIANCE & PROCUREMENT:
- VENDOR SAFETY VERIFICATION: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
  * Automates vendor safety compliance verification across POs & contracts
  * Monitors vendor contract adherence to EHS requirements
  * Reconciles vendor safety profiles with contract terms & procurement
  * Processes compliance exceptions through escalation workflows

- HAZARD TRACKING (supplier): sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1
  * Tracks hazardous material certifications from vendors
  * Executes regulatory verification processes
  * Routes urgent safety alerts for corrective intervention

PART SPECIFICATION & SUPPLIER COMPLIANCE:
- PART SPECS vs SUPPLIER CERTIFICATIONS: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1
  * Validates material specifications against supplier qualifications
  * Automates supplier compliance verification for engineering changes
  * Verifies material standards & enforces engineering standards
  * Capabilities: validate-material-specifications, verify-material-standards, automate-compliance-verification
  * Use case: "Procurement officer confirms supplier certifications for all bill-of-materials items"
  * Related entities: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem
